primitives.name: Cohort Dashboard Capability
primitives.verbatim_quote: # NEXT-006: Content-to-conversion cohort dashboard ## Repo(s) PostHog, Dub, Payload ## Category Measurement ## Goal Implement or design the content-to-conversion cohort dashboard capability for GSE / GSN without touching production data first.
primitives.assumptions: No production data access, isolated development environment, disabled-by-default flag usage.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Initial prototype phase; does not handle edge cases like high-frequency streaming.

layer2.mapping: Maps the dashboard requirement to an information-theoretic efficiency measure that quantifies how effectively user interactions (content consumption) translate into conversion events.
layer2.telemetry: Observation metrics include dashboard load time, API request latency, and simulation accuracy against synthetic data.

primitives.name: Mitigate Manual Steps
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Founder/Internal Value The team gets measurable workflows, fewer manual steps, better observability, and clearer build priorities.
primitives.assumptions: Operational independence from legacy systems, focus on automation.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Batch processing mode; does not support real-time interactive queries.

layer2.mapping: Represents the reduction in manual effort as a decrease in Kolmogorov complexity of the operational workflow, measured by the number of distinct human-executed tasks required per conversion cycle.
layer2.telemetry: Metrics include task count before vs after implementation, error rate in automated versus manual pipelines.

primitives.name: Reduce SaaS Cost
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Legal / License Boundary PostHog: MIT Expat for repo content outside ee; enterprise code under separate license; Dub: AGPLv3 core with ee folders under commercial license; Payload: MIT Do not copy source code from these repos into GSE.
primitives.assumptions: Open-source alternative adoption, volume-based pricing avoidance.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Cost-optimal scaling regime; linear cost increase with dataset size.

layer2.mapping: Models the cost reduction as a ratio of subscription fees for proprietary tools to the computational expense of running equivalent open-source algorithms on cloud infrastructure.
layer2.telemetry: Tracking metrics involve monthly recurring cost (MRC) comparisons and resource utilization rates.

primitives.name: Improve Conversion
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Why It Matters This increases GSE's ability to operate autonomously, learn from users, improve conversion, reduce SaaS cost, and make product/marketing decisions from evidence.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Statistical power threshold; minimum detectable effect size.

layer2.mapping: Expresses conversion improvement as the relative change in the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (ROC-AUC) when incorporating new cohort data into predictive models.
layer2.telemetry: Evaluation metrics include pre/post lift in click-through rates (CTR) and conversion rates (CR).

reasoning_traces.think:
The primary challenge is transforming raw event logs into actionable insights while respecting legal boundaries. We construct a mathematical framework that treats user interactions as samples from an underlying stochastic process. By defining a suitable metric for information flow between content exposure and conversion, we can quantify the value added by the dashboard. This approach leverages concepts from information theory and causal inference to provide a rigorous basis for evaluating the system's effectiveness. Key failure modes include overfitting to noise, violating privacy constraints, and introducing bias through sampling artifacts.
